conditions.name: Common Cold
conditions.description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract. Common symptoms include runny or blocked nose, sneezing, sore throat and cough.

conditions.name: Influenza
conditions.description: A contagious viral respiratory illness that can cause sudden fever, cough, sore throat, muscle aches, chills and fatigue.

conditions.name: Gastroenteritis
conditions.description: Inflammation of the stomach or intestines that may be caused by infections or other factors. Common symptoms include diarrhoea, vomiting, abdominal pain and fever.

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: A type of headache that may involve throbbing pain, nausea, vomiting and sensitivity to light or sound.

conditions.name: Allergic Rhinitis
conditions.description: An allergic reaction to airborne particles that can cause sneezing, an itchy or blocked nose, clear nasal discharge and itchy or watery eyes.

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection
conditions.description: An infection involving the urinary tract, including the bladder or kidneys. Symptoms may include painful or frequent urination, urinary urgency and lower abdominal discomfort.
